alternatives.option: Align dag/stage-map.json to the 8 condensed mathematical pillars (00_statement plus 01_reduction through 07_congruences), narrow Stage 00 to the 3 live files on condensed main (src/Statements.lean and root Challenge.lean with preserve_defs=true; src/Main.lean with preserve_defs=false), enforce closed-world default-deny Lean parsing, and derive DAG depends_on edges strictly from resolved direct Lean import statements among mapped nodes.
alternatives.reason: Matches the live condensed readable edition's src/New/ pillar structure directly while preserving a separate historical Alpoge 20-step map page, keeps formal statement definitions inspectable verbatim, fails closed on unsupported syntax, and reflects true direct imports without inventing edges.

alternatives.option: Retain the original 21-stage Alpoge development-step map (01_stepanov_determinant..20_grh) and stubbed formal_conjectures_* files, or infer DAG dependency edges by cross-matching duplicate declaration names across files.

alternatives.reconsider_when: Upstream re-integrates comparator/FormalConjectures*.lean onto condensed main (expanding Stage 00 from 3 to 5 files) or a future approved requirement replaces import-only DAG edges with a compiler-backed semantic dependency graph.

consequences: Downstream validators, rh-check-upstream and the VitePress explainer builder consume the 8-stage rh-stage-map/v1, rh-dag/v1 and 3 live Stage 00 skeletons with exact upstream line ranges at 41c2716658c4.
